audit_predicates.evidence: Candidate, design, live source, and all nine p179-p181 authority-layer byte/hash identities match the design bindings exactly.
Each of the six candidate TeX labels has zero occurrences in the bound live cohomology.tex.

For fixed p the supports of the tuple factors are locally finite when the original closed family is locally finite. Therefore stalks see only finitely many factors, and the augmented stalk complex is the contractible ordered simplex complex on the nonempty finite set I_x.

For a closed inclusion j, j_* is exact by its stalk description and preserves injectives because its exact left adjoint is restriction. Global sections of j_* agree with global sections on the closed subset; finite products preserve the resulting cohomology calculation.

A flasque resolution is soft on paracompact A; restrictions to closed intersections are soft. At each fixed p the tuple-intersection family is locally finite, so the product of the closed direct-image columns is locally a finite product and is soft. These columns are Gamma-acyclic. K^p is exact stalkwise, and exactness of products in Ab identifies the E1 terms with the stated products of intersection cohomology.

Degreewise exactness of the Godement functor preserves the augmented covering resolution. Its flasque terms make the horizontal spectral sequence collapse to the Godement complex of F, while the vertical spectral sequence has E1=H^q(A,K^p). The first-quadrant double complex converges to H*(A,F).

The augmentation gives the bottom Cech-to-derived edge, and the vertical edge is the compatible family of restrictions. Vanishing for 0<q<n removes every possible differential and filtration obstruction relevant to the displayed three-term sequence in total degree n.

Restriction gives the refinement and trace morphisms of augmented covering resolutions. The standard prism homotopy makes two refinement functions agree from E2 onward; augmentations identify the maps on abutments as identity and restriction respectively. The statement correctly conditions trace naturality on both source and target coverings satisfying an allowed case.

Hypothesis (2) only says R|_B belongs to R(B) when B is a member of that same R. In the k>1 proof, B is a member of R^1 but the proof asserts R^i|_B belongs to R(B) for i=2,...,k. No stated hypothesis yields these cross-cover trace memberships.
The spectral-sequence necessity argument is correct, but the converse invokes the blocked local-killing lemma.
The open-cover local-killing dependency correctly proves B(m), but the final equivalence invokes the blocked Corollary 1 formalization.
Alternating normalization correctly forces covering cohomology above the nerve dimension to vanish, but the final derived-acyclicity conclusion invokes the blocked preceding equivalence.

The exact p181 source finishes Proposition 3.9.2, gives an application and a nonabelian remark, then starts Section 3.10. Those subordinate source units are not claimed by this candidate. The scoped section LayerTarget itself is represented by the candidate section label, so D000329 can remain a section-unit closure without closing the omitted subordinate units.
